messages:
Ava (CS): Hey team — planning a 90m "Skill Sprint" for Cohort 3 (customers in onboarding). Need to lock time + facilitators. Proposing three windows next week: Mon 10:00-11:30 PT, Tue 16:00-17:30 CET, Wed 09:00-10:30 ET. React with emoji for preferred slot or add availability to the poll: https://polly.example/s/abc123 :calendar:
Sam CSM: +1 for Mon morning PT from my side. I'll cover kickoff/expectations. :raised_hands:
Priya G.: Tue CET is tight for me (back-to-back). If we pick Mon PT I can join for the migration demo only.
Diego R.: Wed ET works best for the East-coast customers. Also, can we include a 15m segment on renewal health signals? A few customers in cohort are renewal-risk flagged.
Liam (Enablement): Good call, Diego. Proposed agenda (draft):
```
1) Intros + goals (10m)
2) Migration walkthrough (30m)
3) Cost & observability best-practices (20m)
4) Renewal health signals + action items (15m)
5) Live Q&A (15m)
```
Marta: Love that. Suggest adding a short prework checklist we can send 48h before: install cli, share sample prompt sets, and enable token-logging. Keeps session focused.
Nico (PM): I'm happy to present the observability dashboard demo if we confirm Wed ET. Also can include a short slide on experiments that reduce token cost.
Ava (CS): Flags: a couple of customers have low activation and a risk tag — want the CS owners to join. Sam, Priya, can you confirm you'll invite your accounts?
Sam CSM: Will invite my three accounts. I'll DM their preferred contact.
Priya G.: I can invite mine but may only be present for migration section. I'll record a 5m intro video if needed.
CalendarBot: Poll created: https://polly.example/s/abc123 — current reactions: Mon PT (3), Wed ET (4), Tue CET (1). Poll closes in 48h.
Diego R.: Also, recommend we capture two quick evals: pre-session where customers rate onboarding confidence (1-5), and post-session same metric + open feedback. Helps measure impact.
Liam (Enablement): Agreed. I'll draft a 3-question survey and the post-session follow-up template. Will share by EOD.
Marta: Who's responsible for recording + notes? We should auto-upload recording to the customer folder and drop highlights in the workspace.
Nico (PM): I'll set the meeting to record and upload. Also will add timestamps for key demos.
Ava (CS): Great — action items: Sam/Priya invite accounts; Liam draft survey + prework; Nico record + upload; Marta prepare prework checklist; Diego draft renewal signal slides. We'll finalize by poll close. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
